metadata.label: Purpose
metadata.text: Track awareness, usage, consideration and advertising recall for six streaming services, wave on wave.

metadata.label: Method
metadata.raw_text: Method: Online self-completion. Continuous monthly tracker.

metadata.label: Sample
metadata.text: 600 adults aged 18 and over who watch video content at least weekly, nationally representative on age (18-34: 35%), region and gender.

review.finding: A quota was proposed but not accepted: it names 'S4', which is not a question in this QRE. The sentence is kept as written.
review.evidence: Region (S4) - HARD: North 24%, Midlands 17%, South 41%, Scotland 8%, Wales 5%, Northern Ireland 5%. Close at SO5 when a cell is full.

review.evidence: Gender (D1) - SOFT: at least 280 Male and at least 280 Female. Monitor only; D1 is asked at the end of the interview.

review.finding: The semantics block records three decisions the QRE never states: that a condition naming an unasked question is false, that the first matching rule wins, and that '==' against a multi-select compares the whole answer set. Each changes which questions appear on many routes and needs confirming.
